description: A holographic profile card with spring tilt under the pointer, a patternable holo layer, light glare and parallax depth — plus a status indicator and a contact button.
interactionNotes: The card tilts under the pointer with a spring, the light rotates with it and the hologram layer shifts in place; on touch the same happens with your finger, and with `enableMobileTilt` tilting the phone also moves the card (on iOS it asks for permission on the first touch). Entry is a stretched 1.4-second spring. The geometry is not mirrored: tilt and light are physical.

props.iconUrl: Image for the hologram pattern; without it a soft gradient is used.
props.miniAvatarUrl: Small round avatar next to the handle in the footer.
props.name: Name on the tile — the default is a placeholder, not an invented person.
props.title: Below the name.
props.handle: The handle in the footer (without @; it is added for you).
props.showUserInfo: Whether the handle/status/contact footer is shown.
props.contactHref: If passed, the contact button becomes a real link (new tab, `rel=noreferrer`).
props.backdropColor: Background color of the tile; the hologram foil derives from how dark or light this color is. Omitting it means the theme tile.
props.glare: Intensity of the following light glare; 0 to 1.
props.parallax: Layer movement with the pointer, in pixels.
props.autoPreview: Auto demo: an imaginary pointer slowly circles the card so tilt, glare and hologram are visible in non-interactive previews (bento/list). It turns off with `prefers-reduced-motion`.

tips: ⚠️ This component's CSS variable prefix is `--pfc-*`, not `--pc-*` — that prefix belongs to sponsor-card in this repo (precedent: paper-crumple with `--pcr-*`). The names were changed mechanically and no value differs.

The hologram foil derives from how dark or light `backdropColor` is (dark surface = color-dodge, light = multiply) — so the backdrop color also changes the hologram's character, not just the background.

The text defaults ("online"/"message") were made Persian; pass the Persian name and title from props and set the Persian line's `line-height` deliberately (1.25 for the name / 1.45 for the title — above the font ink).
On mobile you get two separate sensations: touching the card itself and — with `enableMobileTilt` — tilting the phone itself; the iOS permission pattern is automatic.
In the light theme the foil gets `invert(1) hue-rotate(180deg)` — pass the dark color pattern so it looks right in both themes.
